content: Use the current Mulch CLI through `ml`, not the legacy `mulch` shim. Repo-local agent guidance should prime Mulch with `ml prime` and Canopy with `cn prime`, while Overstory hooks should call `ml` for Mulch automation.

Keep VeloRail domain roles as Seeds labels plus agents/<role>.md guidance unless Overstory is explicitly upgraded for custom task-scoped capabilities. Refresh GitNexus after commits through scripts/gitnexus-analyze-after-commit.sh, wired from both .beads/hooks/post-commit and .overstory/hooks.json.

description: Codex workers launched by Overstory could not commit, send mail, or record Mulch because workspace-write only included the worktree and .overstory; linked-worktree Git metadata under .git/worktrees plus .mulch, .seeds, and .canopy were outside the sandbox.
resolution: Patched installed Overstory Codex runtime to use /Applications/Codex.app/Contents/Resources/codex and to pass --add-dir for .git, .overstory, .mulch, .seeds, and .canopy when present. Future ov sling worker sessions get explicit writable access to canonical orchestration directories.

name: Vite 7 supported Node wrapper
description: VeloRail pins Node 22.13.1 with .nvmrc/.node-version and routes Vite dev/build/preview scripts through scripts/with-supported-node.mjs so Vite runs on Node ^20.19.0 or >=22.12.0 even when the shell default is older.

outcomes.test_results: npm run quality passed; dev server selected Node 22.13.1 but bind failed with sandbox EPERM

name: VeloRail real quality gate
description: VeloRail quality gates now run node --test over tests/*.test.js, scripts/lint-style.mjs for whitespace/newline style checks, TypeScript project checking, and a Vite production build through scripts/with-supported-node.mjs.

name: Browser smoke tests for user-facing regressions
description: Use Playwright browser tests under tests/browser with npm run test:browser to build the app, serve a preview on 127.0.0.1:4174, and verify route-search feedback plus popover clipping before handing UI changes to the user.

name: Gated Seeds close wrapper
description: Seeds issue closure now goes through npm run issue:close, which runs npm run quality by default, auto-requires strict Playwright browser tests for UI/map/feature work, supports gate labels for overrides, and blocks direct sd close through the Overstory PreToolUse policy.
